system.description:
Crude impersonations pale beside this power. You forge an entire new identity - appearance, speech, aura, even thought processes - virtually impossible to see through.

Spend three hours in relative peace to establish a persona, then spend a permanent Willpower Trait and make a Static Mental Challenge against the Storyteller (typical difficulty at least 10 Traits, more for complex personalities). Once created, you may step into the identity at will with no test; your aura, Nature, Demeanor, thoughts and even Merits and Flaws all read as genuine. You may hold many identities but only one is active at a time; switching costs a Willpower Trait and a minute's concentration. Short of Methuselah-level Auspex, the only way to catch the fraud is to notice discrepancies between the persona and the skills it should have (a Static Social Challenge vs the Storyteller).
system.duration: Permanent identity; switching costs one Willpower Trait and a minute
